metadata.name: Webhook Trigger
metadata.summary: Generic inbound HTTP webhook trigger for Greentic flows
metadata.description: Ships the webhook trigger nodeType (trigger contract v1: the flow is started by a verified HTTP call to <deployment-prefix>/trigger/<trigger_id>) plus four design-time tools (validate_webhook_config, suggest_path, infer_auth_from_curl, suggest_verification). The runtime (greentic-start) verifies the raw body (HMAC-SHA256/SHA1 or bearer), answers the Meta subscription handshake, deduplicates deliveries and enters the flow at the node after the trigger.

tools.name: suggest_path
tools.description: Slugify an intent into a trigger_id and the route the runtime mounts it at (e.g. 'Receive Stripe events' → trigger_id stripe_events, route /trigger/stripe_events).
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"intent":{"type":"string","description":"What the webhook receives, e.g. \"Receive Stripe events\". Non-alphanumeric characters become '-', filler words (receive, incoming, for, from, the, a, an, to, into) are dropped once the intent has more than two words, and the slug is placed under \"/webhooks/\". An intent that slugifies to nothing is an error."}},"required":["intent"]}

tools.name: infer_auth_from_curl
tools.description: Infer the webhook trigger's verify block (hmac-sha256/sha1 or bearer) from a sample curl an upstream system would send. Secret refs are returned as names (webhook/signing_key); the token in the curl is never copied. Timestamped schemes (Slack, Stripe) are reported as unsupported.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"curl_cmd":{"type":"string","description":"A sample curl the upstream system would send INTO the webhook, e.g. \"curl -X POST https://host/webhooks/stripe -H 'Stripe-Signature: t=1,v1=abc'\". The method comes from -X/--request (default POST), the path from the URL, and the auth shape from the Authorization and signature headers."}},"required":["curl_cmd"]}

tools.name: suggest_verification
tools.description: Return the verify (and challenge / idempotency) block for a known sender: threads, instagram, facebook, whatsapp or meta (HMAC-SHA256 + Meta handshake), github (HMAC-SHA256 + X-GitHub-Delivery dedup), or any other name for a bearer preset.
